provenance.method: Curated atomic synthesis from open botanical references, taxonomic backbones, nomenclatural standards, peer-reviewed classification and editorial consensus; no verbatim source passages embedded.

warnings: Botanical terms may denote homology, function, or ecological strategy; those meanings must not be conflated. Taxonomic names and accepted circumscriptions are version-dependent. The core scope is land plants (Embryophyta), not an unqualified historical kingdom Plantae.
